Demonstrate high resolution optical payload and attitude control with propulsion.
Description

Demonstrate the functionality of a high resolution optical payload and attitude control propulsion system on a Cubesat class Nano-satellite. GSD 5 m from LEO and 5 km swath.
Failure cause Only awake when there’s Sun illumination. Investigation seems to indicate a combined problem among the solar panels, battery charging capability, as well as the EPS itself.
